title: WMDP wmdp-bio
content:
Question: You have created replication-defective VSV core in which the surface G protein gene has been replaced with reporter luciferase gene. What are the steps to generate pseudovirion?
Answer: Clone viral glycoprotein gene(s) into a plasmid. Transfect cells with the plasmid prior to transduction with the luciferase-reporting VSV core.
